# Coding Standards Checklist

## File Header
- [ ] All files include the mandatory header
- [ ] Author, Created, Last Modified fields are correct
- [ ] Description, Project, and Module fields are accurate

## Clean Code
- [ ] No dead code or commented-out blocks
- [ ] Functions are small and single-purpose
- [ ] Guard clauses used where appropriate
- [ ] No unnecessary abstraction

## Naming & Structure
- [ ] camelCase / PascalCase / UPPER_SNAKE_CASE used correctly
- [ ] File and folder names follow conventions
- [ ] Imports → constants → functions → exports order followed

## Git Discipline
- [ ] Commit messages follow the required format
- [ ] Commits are small and logical
- [ ] Branch name follows conventions

## Linting & Formatting
- [ ] Linter passes with no warnings
- [ ] No unused imports
- [ ] 2-space indentation, semicolons, single quotes
- [ ] Max line length respected

## Security
- [ ] No sensitive data included
- [ ] Inputs validated where applicable
- [ ] No dangerous patterns (eval, dynamic imports)

## Documentation
- [ ] Functions include short descriptions
- [ ] Parameters and return values documented
- [ ] PR description is complete and clear

---

## Additional Notes
Add any context, risks, follow-up tasks, or reviewer notes here.
